URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/27/wildfires-in-southwest-europe-what-we-know-so-far
(Al Jazeera, dated 27 July 2026; background + EU assistance + senior quotes)

SCALE:
- France: 115,000 hectares burned since January.
- Spain: 119,458 hectares as of 22 July; 150,000+ since January (6x last year's total).
- Evacuations: 220,000 France; 100,000 Spain; 30,000 ordered to shelter in place in Spain.

DEATHS: At least 12 killed in Spain's Andalusia region wildfire on 10 July.

QUOTES:
- Interior Minister Laurent Nunez: "We are in a situation that is unprecedented."
- President Emmanuel Macron: "The situation we are dealing with today is the most severe we ever recorded, the toughest since the Second World War."
- France's National Firefighters Federation spokesman: "We have reached a point of 'operational impossibility'" — due to unprecedented pyrocumulonimbus clouds, a phenomenon previously unseen in France.
- Bordeaux Mayor Thomas Cazenave: fire was just 15km from the city; Cap Ferret peninsula severely ravaged.

EU CIVIL PROTECTION ASSISTANCE:
- Greece and Italy sent firefighting aircraft to Spain.
- Portugal deployed 100+ military personnel.
- Turkey sending two aircraft.
- Switzerland sending two Super Puma helicopters to France.

CLIMATE: Europe warming twice as fast as global average since 1980 (Copernicus).
